subject: Post-call recap: stakeholder lattice + legal handoff cadence

From: laura_bennett
To: Tom Garcia <t.garcia@cloudhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter, jasmine_liu
Date: 2027-09-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + proposed next steps (stakeholder lattice & legal handoff cadence)

Tom — thanks for a productive 45m today. High-level recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned.

Call highlights (short):
- Decision criteria you called out: predictable unit cost, private deployment option (VPC/on-prem later), and data residency controls.
- Economic buyer: you (Tom) confirmed you own the P&L sign-off with procurement influence from procurement@cloudhealth.com.
- Security/infosec: Emma Li will validate SOC 2 scope and DPA requirements.
- Legal: Fiona Park (GC) will handle MSA/DPA review and redlines.

Proposed handoff cadence (our recommendation):
1) NDA out immediately (1 business day) so your team can share sample data schemas and test plan.
2) Security pack (SOC2 attestation + answers) shared within 48 hours after NDA returns.
3) MSA + DPA seed sent for redline — ask: target 3 business day turnaround for initial redline from CloudHealth legal; we'll aim for 3 business days from our side for responses.
4) Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to be shared as an editable spreadsheet with named owners and due dates (we'll include delivery milestones and rollout gates).

Attachments I will send now: blank MAP, MSA seed (internal redline version), SOC2 attestation stub.

Asks from you: please confirm Fiona and procurement@cloudhealth.com are the right legal/procurement contacts and whether the 3-business-day initial redline expectation is realistic.

Next meeting: propose 30m follow-up on Wednesday 9/15 to review MSA navigation and any security questions — I can block 30m at 10:00am PT if that works.

Thanks — Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Laura — great summary, thanks. Confirming contacts: Fiona (GC) and procurement@cloudhealth.com are correct. Emma (security) is cc'd here and will start a preliminary list of items we need for our compliance review.

On redline cadence: 3 business days for an initial MSA redline is aggressive but reasonable for our size if you send a clean seed and highlight non-negotiables up front. For complex commercial terms we may need up to 5 business days. Can your legal team highlight the three clauses you expect are most likely to be negotiated? That will help Fiona triage.

We can do the 9/15 10am PT check-in. Please share the MAP and MSA seed before EOD.

Appreciate the clarity — Tom

Tom — perfect, thanks for confirming.
Ben — looping you in to own the legal handoff and to set expectations with our contracts team. Ben, anything specific you want me to call out in the seed to expedite their first pass?

Per Tom's ask, our three likely negotiation hotspots (based on similar deals):
- Liability cap & carve-outs for data processing (we can propose a middle ground to speed things up).
- Data residency/data processing clauses in the DPA — Emma, can you flag any additional requirements?
- Termination for convenience notice & transition support fees.

I've attached the MAP and MSA seed (internal redline v1) and the SOC2 attestation. I'll also add a short 'non-negotiables' cover note at the top of the MSA document to speed legal triage.

Attachments: CloudHealth_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx, Redline_MSAs_v1.docx, SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Short note from contracts side:
- We'll mark the MSA with 'high priority' and include a cover memo that calls out the 3 items Laura listed. That memo helps legal prioritize.
- Our standard target: initial MSA response within 3 business days (we meet that ~70% of the time). If CloudHealth sends more than one significant commercial change at once, that can extend to 5 business days.
- For NDA: we can have a standard bilateral NDA executed same-day once signatures are in DocuSign.

Operational asks for CloudHealth to speed review: please indicate which data classes require residency constraints and whether the PII classification is different for EU vs US data (if applicable).

I'll coordinate with our legal ops to queue the MSA and will ping Fiona directly if we see prolonged turnaround.

— Ben
